name: storage-destructive-v1
description: Destructive NVMe RMA validation. Full-capacity write to flush SLC cache, then write+verify to catch data corruption, then mixed 70/30 QD32 for controller stability. CAUTION: overwrites all data on the DUT. Requires --destructive flag and serial re-entry confirmation.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. SMART and OCP health captured at run start.

phases.name: full-write
phases.notes: 10 min sequential full-capacity write. Flushes SLC write cache. Forces FTL into steady-state TLC/QLC writes.

phases.name: write-verify
phases.notes: 20 min sequential write + CRC32c verify. Any verify_mismatches > 0 = FAIL (fio_verify_mismatch). Catches silent data corruption, bad blocks, FTL defects.

phases.name: mixed-rw
phases.notes: 5 min 70/30 random R/W at QD32. Controller stability under mixed load. Catches DRAM cache bugs and thermal collapse under sustained QD32.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 3 min cooldown. SMART and OCP health captured at run end, compared to pre-run.
